args.sql:
WITH chain_stats AS (
    SELECT
        zadanie,
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        COUNT(*) as attempts_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_success,
        MIN(CASE WHEN status = 'Успешно' THEN nomer_popytki ELSE NULL END) as first_success_attempt
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY zadanie, kod_tsepochki_zapuskov
),
retry_success AS (
    SELECT
        zadanie,
        kod_tsepochki_zapuskov,
        attempts_count
    FROM chain_stats
    WHERE has_success = 1 AND first_success_attempt > 1
),
total_chains AS (
    SELECT
        zadanie,
        COUNT(DISTINCT kod_tsepochki_zapuskov) as total_chains
    FROM "08_fonovye_zadaniya"
    GROUP BY zadanie
)
SELECT
    t.zadanie,
    COUNT(r.kod_tsepochki_zapuskov) as retry_success_chains,
    t.total_chains,
    COUNT(r.kod_tsepochki_zapuskov) * 1.0 / t.total_chains as share_retry_success,
    AVG(r.attempts_count) as avg_attempts_retry_success
FROM total_chains t
LEFT JOIN retry_success r ON t.zadanie = r.zadanie
GROUP BY t.zadanie, t.total_chains
ORDER BY t.zadanie
